title: RCAN Physical Envelope (informative, v0.1)
description: Machine-readable declaration of the physical limits a robot's safety gate enforces, independent of any AI model. Appendix C (Physical Assurance Profile) requirement R1. Informative in this version: RCAN does not yet require it. The envelope is written and signed by the integrator, never by the model. All numeric values are the integrator's declaration; nothing in this schema checks that the declared limits are adequate for the task or the site. Top-level and limit blocks reject unknown keys so that a misspelled limit fails validation instead of being silently ignored.

envelope_version.description: Envelope schema version. Quote it in YAML ("0.1") so it is not parsed as a number.

id.description: Integrator's identifier for this machine. MAY be an RRN.

class.description: Machine class, for example mobile_ground, tabletop_arm, mobile_manipulator, legged. Free text in v0.1.

level.description: Physical assurance level claimed by the integrator (A1 Declared, A2 Enforced, A3 Assured). Self-declared unless third-party evidence accompanies it. Independent of the RCAN protocol conformance levels L1-L4: do not put an L-level here.

frame.description: Coordinate frame the polygons are expressed in (e.g. map, base_link).

keep_in.description: The machine (or tool point) must stay inside this polygon.

keep_out.description: Regions the machine (or tool point) must never enter.

z_range_m.description: Optional [min, max] height band in metres, for arms and other machines that move in 3D.

max_speed_mps.description: Maximum linear speed of the machine, or of the tool centre point for an arm.

proximity.description: Rules applied when a human is detected within a distance. Rules with a smaller distance take precedence.

max_state_age_ms.description: State older than this is stale; the gate decides stop.

category.description: Stop category as defined in IEC 60204-1.

max_time_ms.description: Declared worst-case time from stop request to standstill, at max_speed_mps.

max_distance_m.description: Declared worst-case travel from stop request to standstill, at max_speed_mps.

on_loss.description: Fail closed. Loss of heartbeat always leads to stop; no other value is valid.

resolver.description: Where authority is resolved. Identity and delegation mechanics are out of scope for this profile.

signature.description: Integrator's signature over the canonical JSON of this envelope with the signature member removed, as <alg>:<value>. Produced by the integrator, never by the model.
